title: C21 Testing (RSC + Server Action + Route Handler + E2E)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task
solutions/** except solutions/c21-testing/** (T-04/T-13/T-15 solutions are READ-ONLY context)

acceptance_criteria: A unit/integration test exercises the C03 product RSC (T-04) in isolation and asserts its output, and the test passes (QA functional: the RSC representative solution includes a passing test that exercises the server component in isolation). The C03 solution is read for context only and never modified.

A test invokes the C11 Server Action (T-13) directly and asserts its return value and side effect, and it passes (QA functional: the Server Action representative solution includes a passing test that invokes the action).

A test exercises the C13 search Route Handler (T-15) via a simulated request and asserts the response, and it passes (QA functional: the Route Handler representative solution includes a passing test that exercises the handler).

A Playwright E2E covers one key flow (e.g. listing -> product -> add to cart) and is tagged so the Automation Gate can classify it; testing-the-boundary.md documents how to test across the server/client boundary.

The c21 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts. NOTE (independence): the three target solutions are READ-ONLY inputs — this task adds only its own tests under solutions/c21-testing/ and must not edit those challenges' files.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
